The bundle is $699 and the US plug is the only one live right now. Worth flagging: S1 batch 2 is still in transit to the warehouse, so it ships as soon as that lands, not straight away.

sure
Searched the catalog · Lucky LV08 miner

Roughly 300W at the wall for the pair, 10 TH/s at ~150W for the S1 and 7 TH/s at ~150W for the LV08 Pro. That's about 17 TH/s total, and around 216 kWh a month running 24/7.

Both are quiet-ish desktop units, S1 around 50 dB.

What state are you in? I'll turn that 216 kWh into an actual monthly dollar figure and show what the pair stacks.
new mexico
Ran the power-cost calculator

New Mexico residential runs around 14 cents a kWh, so call it roughly $30 a month for the pair at 216 kWh. Check your own bill's per-kWh line, that's the number that matters.

Straight talk: at retail power, home mining like this is about stacking sats and the solo block shot, not profit at today's BTC price.

Per dollar of hashrate, the Magic Miner 40T at $799 for 40 TH/s beats this pair. Want me to price that one out too?
suer
Read the magic miner 40t page

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at ~650W, BM1370 x30, tunable 30 TH/s @ 450W up to 50 TH/s @ 850W, ~50 dB in Eco.

At 14 cents that's about $66 a month running 40 TH/s, or about $45 in Eco at 30 TH/s. So roughly double the Nexus pair's power bill for more than double the hashrate, $20 a TH versus $41.

Current stock is Batch 6, so let me confirm that batch's ship date rather than quote you the old one. Want it priced in a cart alongside?
